monitor.no_frames: No frames: {source} hasn't sent anything on universe {u}. Nothing is going out.
monitor.all_zero: Frames are going out but every channel is 0: check MASTER, blackout, the grand master and what's playing.
monitor.learn_tip: Make a named input from this message

monitor.sim_in: Simulated MIDI input (no ports in the simulator)
monitor.no_out: No MIDI outputs set up. Tick “MIDI out” on a port in Setup > Plugged in.
live.drag_tip: Drag to put the buttons in your order
haze.preset_tip: Haze presets from the rig file (e.g. Haze 4 Med)
haze.live_note: Changes apply straight away; Save writes them to the rig file.
haze.test_tip: Run one cycle of this mode now (max on and rest still apply)
layout.tool_select_tip: Tap a light to select it, shift-tap to add, or drag a box round several
layout.tool_lasso_tip: Draw round the lights to select
layout.tool_move_tip: Drag the selected lights to where they are
layout.problem_overlap: {a} and {b} are in the same place
layout.problems_help: Spread these out: spatial effects use where the lights are, so lights in one spot always show the same part of an effect. Tap a line to select both.
layout.uni_tip: Which universe to show in the stage view and the address map
layout.print_tip: Print the patch sheet (or Save as PDF) for load-in
layout.png_tip: Save the patch sheet as a picture
layout.addr_no_frames: {source}: no frames sent on universe {u} - nothing is going out
layout.addr_all_zero: {source}: frames are going out but every channel is 0
layout.status_none: U{u}: no output sends this universe
layout.revert_confirm: Throw away every change since the layout was last saved?
layout.need_pixels: Select a light with pixels (a bar)
info.live.shows.title: Shows
info.live.shows.text: Tap a show to run it; its sets (LOW, MID, HIGH ...) appear underneath. Drag a button to put the buttons in your order: they keep their places, and new shows go at the end.
info.live.generated.title: Starter and generated
info.live.generated.text: Shows and scenes made by the setup wizard or the generator (Review page). They play like any other; open one in Scenes or Shows to make it your own.
info.layout.stage.title: Stage
info.layout.stage.text: Where the lights are, as seen from above with the back of the stage at the top. Spatial effects use these places, so lights in one spot show the same part of an effect. Wheel to zoom, Space + drag to pan, Fit (0) for the whole rig.
info.live.haze.title: Haze settings
info.live.haze.text: How hard and how often the haze machine runs in each mode, for this rig. Changes apply at once; Save writes them to the rig file. Scenes and shows never set haze (rule 5): only these controls do.
layout.fit_tip: Zoom to fit every light (0). Wheel zooms; middle button or Space + drag pans
layout.select_help: Tap a light, drag a box, or pick a group above
layout.kept_unsaved: The show files changed; your unsaved layout is kept
groups.title: Groups
groups.need_name: Type a name for the group first
groups.confirm_delete: Delete group {name}? Scenes that use it must be changed first.
heads.save_need: Hold at least one head on a pad first
midi.learning: learning {action}: press a pedal or hit a pad…
midi.mapping_sum: every message and what it does, including ones not given a name
setup.unstable: no serial number: kept by its port
files.confirm_restore: Put {file} back as it was before "{note}"?
scenes.px_group_need: Select some pixels first (click a segment of a bar)
scenes.discard: Throw away the changes to this scene?
scenes.overwrite: There's already a scene {key}. Replace it?
scenes.confirm_delete: Delete scene {name}? Shows that use it must be changed first.
scenes.add_layer: Add layer for the selected lights
scenes.no_layer: Select lights on the layout, then add a layer.
scenes.select_first: Select some lights on the layout first
scenes.select_help: Tap lights, drag a box, or pick a group
scenes.level_help: how strongly this layer's colour counts
scenes.blend_help: replace: covers what's below; max: the brighter wins; add: adds up
top.tempo_tip: Tempo: where it comes from, and a pulse on each beat
shows.title: Shows
shows.name_placeholder: show name, e.g. Main band show
shows.discard: Throw away the changes to this show?
shows.overwrite: There's already a show {key}. Replace it?
shows.confirm_delete: Delete show {name}? Setlists that use it must be changed first.
shows.set_name_prompt: Name for the new set, e.g. chorus
shows.fade_help: crossfade between steps, unless a step says otherwise
setlists.title: Setlists
setlists.discard: Throw away the changes to this setlist?
override.no_panels: No Override panels yet: tick Edit panels to make one.
override.label: label
override.fixtures: lights or groups, e.g. bars, kick

access.no_pin: No PIN set: only this computer can open the app
access.pin_saved: PIN saved; phones need to sign in again
access.pin_removed: PIN removed; phone/LAN access is off
access.confirm_clear: Remove the PIN? Phone/LAN access goes off with it.
access.lan: Phones and other computers can connect (needs the PIN)
access.pin_local: Ask for the PIN on this computer too
access.lan_help: On a phone on the same Wi-Fi, scan this or type the address, then sign in with the PIN.
login.title: Sign in
login.help: Type the PIN set on the lighting laptop.
history.title: Undo and redo
scenes.copy_tip: Copy the layer being edited, or the look of the first selected light (Ctrl+C)
scenes.paste_tip: Paste the copied look onto the selected lights; position and gobo only go where they fit (Ctrl+V)
scenes.nothing_to_copy: Pick a layer, or a light that a layer lights
scenes.paste_none: None of the selected lights can take that look
project.title: Show file
project.path_placeholder: full path of the show file, e.g. C:\Users\me\OneDrive\Music\Gig.dms
project.confirm_switch: Open {name}? The lights go dark for a few seconds while the app restarts on it.
project.saved_folder: Saved as {name}; open it to keep working in that file
status.lost_title: Lost the connection to the lighting laptop
status.lost_help: The lights keep running. Reconnecting by itself…
midi.confirm_remove: Remove this mapping? (Save the MIDI map to keep the change.)
fixtures.find_tip: Light just this fixture so you can see which it is
fixtures.remove_tip: Take this light out of the patch and every rig
fixtures.confirm_remove: Remove {id} from the patch and every rig? Scenes that name it must be changed first.
fixtures.auto_patch_tip: Give every light the next free addresses, in this order
fixtures.no_types: No fixture types yet: make one or import one.
fixtures.type_key_prompt: Short name for the new type, e.g. par64
fixtures.type_in_use: {key} is still patched: remove those lights first
fixtures.pick_mode: This fixture has several modes: {modes}. Which one is it set to?
fixtures.imported: Imported as {key}: check it against the manual, then save
fixtures.imported_warn: Imported as {key} with {n} warning(s): check it against the manual, then save
fixtures.change_fade_s: Fade when picking a scene or show (s)
fixtures.tempo_timeout: Keep the tempo for (s) when it stops
fixtures.outputs_help: One line per interface; settings as name=value, e.g. port=COM3 universe=0 or host=192.168.1.50.
wizard.title: Setup wizard
wizard.open_help: DMX interface, lights, rule profile, a starter show and the PIN, step by step.
wizard.finished: All set up. Change anything later on the Fixtures and Setup pages.
wizard.interface_help: Pick the DMX interface plugged into this laptop, or a network node. You can add more outputs later.
wizard.none_found: Nothing plugged in that looks like a DMX interface. Plug it in and run the wizard again, or pick network or simulator.
wizard.drv_usb_dmx_open: a USB DMX interface (Open DMX style)
wizard.lights_help: Say how many of each type. They're given free DMX addresses in order; set them on the lights to match (Fixtures page shows them).
wizard.lights_more: Not listed? Import it from the Open Fixture Library or make it on the Fixtures page, then come back.
wizard.profile_help: The safety rules are always on. This picks the rest; change it any time on the Fixtures page.
wizard.profile_generic: Generic: lights follow the scenes, standard dimmers (most rigs)
wizard.profile_band: 0.05 band: MASTER switches the rig on and off, drum hits flash it while it's off
wizard.starter_help: A starter show made for your lights: warm, blue, rainbow, chase, wave, sparkle (and circles for moving heads), in a calm and a lively set.
wizard.starter_make: Make the starter show and play it
wizard.starter_replace: There's already a starter show. Replace it?
wizard.pin_help: Set a PIN now if phones or other computers will connect (turn that on later in Setup). You can skip this.

setup.replace_confirm: Give {mac} the name and universe of {name}, and use it in place of {name} in the rig?
setup.replaced_unconfirmed: {name} replaced in the rig, but the spare hasn't confirmed yet: check it's in range
setup.node_setup: Node firmware {fw}; fallback looks stored for {n} universe(s)
setup.node_resend_tip: Store what each universe shows if the laptop goes away (the static look) on the node

setup.radio_moved: Node and receivers moving to channel {ch}

alerts.minimise: Minimise to the red light (critical: can't be dismissed while it lasts)

heads.desc_placeholder: Description, e.g. lead singer mic, centre front, head height
heads.fine_tip: Fine mode: a drag moves the head a tenth as far, for small adjustments
heads.need_name: Give the point a name (lower case, digits, _ or -)
heads.rename_to: New name for the point (every scene using it follows)
heads.store_title: Store the held heads to a point
heads.walk: Re-focus walk: every point, head by head
midi.bad_id: Names use lower case letters, digits, _ or -
midi.calibrate_help: Pick a level, play the pad a few times at that strength, then press Done. Quiet, normal and loud set how hard hits count.
midi.calibrate_play: Play {name} {level} a few times, then press Done
midi.confirm_delete_device: Delete the device {name} and its inputs?
midi.device_exported: Saved as a device profile in this show
midi.new_input_id: Name for the new input (lower case, e.g. cowbell)
palettes.bad_name: Names use lower case letters, digits, _ or -

palettes.name: Name

wheel.preview_locked: Live preview is off during gig lock
wheel.title: Colour
steps.prog_empty: Nothing in the programmer: set something for the selected lights first
steps.clear_tip: Take it out of this step: the lights track the step before
steps.release_tip: Turn it off from this step on (colour off, channel at 0)
steps.no_movers: No moving heads selected (U'Kings are colour only).
steps.xy_tip: Drag to aim; the box is the head's limits
steps.no_beam: The selected lights have no beam channels.
steps.select_lights: Select lights on the stage (or a group above) to program them.
steps.rec_merge_tip: Add the programmer to this step (what it doesn't touch stays)
steps.rec_overwrite_tip: This step becomes just what's in the programmer
steps.rec_update_tip: Change only what this step already sets
steps.copy_values_tip: Copy what the first selected light shows at this step
steps.pick_tip: Tick steps to change their times together or loop them
steps.insert_after: Insert a step after this one
steps.live_tip: Live: the rig shows the step as you program it. Off = blind (nothing sent)
steps.name: Name
steps.title: Steps
steps.tracking_help: A step keeps everything from the step before; only set what changes.
steps.effects_on_top: Effects on top of the steps
autopilot.class_exclude: leave out of the auto show
autopilot.energy: Energy from the drums and pads (MIDI)
autopilot.haze: Haze (its own controls: the auto show never touches it)
autopilot.learn_help: Learn: tap a control, then hit a pad or press a pedal to map it
review.banned_toast: Banned: the autopilot and generator won't use it
autopilot.capture: Save this look as a scene
autopilot.why_open: Open this look on the Review page
claude.title: Connect to Claude
claude.help: Optional: Claude Desktop or Claude Code on this laptop can read and edit this show in plain words ("make a slow blue scene with the heads on the kit"). Its changes are checked against every rule like yours, backed up and undoable, and gig lock stops them.
claude.setup_title: Set up on a new laptop
claude.step_app: Install 0.05 DMX Suite. The Claude tools come with it, nothing else to install.
claude.step_install: Install Claude Desktop or Claude Code and open it once.
claude.step_restart: Restart Claude. 0.05 DMX Suite then shows in its connectors list, and this ticks when Claude first checks in.
claude.no_program: The program Claude would start is missing ({path}). Reinstall 0.05 DMX Suite.
claude.none_found: Neither Claude Desktop nor Claude Code was found on this laptop. Install one and open it once, then press Check again.
claude.target_other: {app}: connected to another show or install ({shows}). Press Update to point it here.
claude.never_seen: Claude hasn't checked in since the app started.
claude.after: Restart Claude after connecting or disconnecting. The previous Claude settings are kept next to them as .bak.
info.top.status.title: Status strip
info.top.status.text: One tile for each part of the rig: engine, DMX outputs, MIDI, nodes, Claude and screens. The dot shows how each is doing. Tap a DMX or MIDI tile to watch it on the Monitor page.
info.top.alerts.title: Alerts
info.top.alerts.text: What's offline or failing, now and earlier. Dismissed alerts come back only if the device recovers and drops out again. Mute a device you're not using today; it stays muted for this rig.
info.live.scenes.title: Scenes
info.live.scenes.text: Tap a scene to play it. Drag a button to put the buttons in your order. Under the 0.05 band profile scenes only set colour: MASTER turns the lights on and off (rule 1).
info.live.setlist.title: Setlist
info.live.setlist.text: Tonight's songs in order, each with its show, scene or autopilot preset. Tap a song, or step through with Next and Previous or a pedal.
info.live.masters.title: Masters
info.live.masters.text: The grand master scales brightness only: it never moves heads, changes colour or touches haze (rule 6). Sub-masters do the same for one kind of light. MASTER in the top bar turns the rig on and off.
info.haze.manual.title: Manual
info.haze.manual.text: Haze runs at this level until you turn it off. The safety limits still apply: it rests after the longest run, and turns itself off after the auto-off time. Test runs it briefly.
info.haze.pulse.title: Pulse
info.haze.pulse.text: Haze in bursts: on for the on time at the pulse level, then off until the next one. The line underneath shows how much of the time it's on.
info.haze.boost.title: Boost
info.haze.boost.text: A short burst at the boost level, then back to what was running. Held from a button it lasts while held, otherwise for the boost time. The cooldown stops it firing again straight away.
info.haze.safety.title: Safety
info.haze.safety.text: Limits that always apply, in every mode: the longest the machine runs before it rests, how long it rests, and when haze turns itself off. Default mode is what haze starts in.
info.autopilot.autopilot.title: Autopilot
info.autopilot.autopilot.text: Turns the autopilot on: it picks looks from the FX banks to suit the mood, LOW, MID, HIGH, or Auto to follow the drums. Hold keeps the look; Previous and Next step through looks. It never touches haze.
info.autopilot.fx.title: FX banks
info.autopilot.fx.text: The Move, Flash and Colour FX the autopilot chooses from; only what this rig can do is offered. Tap one to use it now (green: running). Exclude… or holding a type down leaves it out of the autopilot: it turns red and stays here to play by hand. Flash FX play over everything while held.
info.autopilot.palette.title: Palette
info.autopilot.palette.text: The colours the autopilot uses. Lock keeps this palette, so the autopilot stops changing it.
info.autopilot.feel.title: Feel
info.autopilot.feel.text: Speed (¼× to 4×), fade (how soft colour changes are), fan (spread across the lights), size (how big the movement or how wide the pixels) and shift (phase offset). Set them for everything, then per bank on top.
info.autopilot.presets.title: Presets
info.autopilot.presets.text: Save the autopilot as it is now (banks, palette, feel) to call up in a song or setlist. Re-roll picks new choices for whatever isn't ticked under Keep.
info.autopilot.priority.title: Control priority
info.autopilot.priority.text: Highest first: blackout, MASTER off (drum flash), Flash FX and Override buttons, hold, then the autopilot or the running show. Letting go of a higher one hands back to the one below.
info.autopilot.why.title: Why did it do that?
info.autopilot.why.text: The autopilot's latest decisions, newest first, each with its reason, so you can see what it reacted to.
info.autopilot.lights.title: Lights
info.autopilot.lights.text: How each light is used, from what it can do. Change one, or leave it out. The kick light and haze are never part of it.
info.override.panels.title: Override
info.override.panels.text: Buttons and faders you lay out yourself, to play the lights by hand over the show. Letting go fades back to the show over the release fade; Release all lets go of everything. Tick Edit panels to change them.
info.scenes.layers.title: Layers
info.scenes.layers.text: A scene is a stack of layers, each one effect on some lights. A layer's blend (replace, max or add) says how it mixes with the layers under it. Pick a layer to edit it.
info.scenes.layer.title: Layer
info.scenes.layer.text: One effect on some lights: what it does, its level and blend, and how it spreads across them (direction, spread and the stage layout for spatial effects).
info.scenes.settings.title: Scene settings
info.scenes.settings.text: For the whole scene: the colour of its button, and its length (one cycle, used by shows for times through).
info.steps.bar.title: Step scene settings
info.steps.bar.text: For the whole step scene: step time or beats, fade time, playback (loop, once, bounce), what moves it on (the timer, a pedal, or a drum such as the snare), how heads move and the dark time.
info.steps.list.title: Steps
info.steps.list.text: Click a step to go to it. + inserts, ⧉ duplicates, ⎘ copies, ✕ deletes; drag to reorder. Tick several to set their times together or loop them. A red outline is a problem: hover for why.
info.steps.programmer.title: Programmer
info.steps.programmer.text: Each value says where it comes from: set in this step, tracked from an earlier step (italics) or in the programmer. Clear takes it out of this step so the step before shows through; Release turns it off from this step on.
info.steps.record.title: Record
info.steps.record.text: Record adds the programmer to the step and keeps the rest; Record over makes the step just the programmer; Record as new step adds one after this; Update step changes only what the step already sets.
info.steps.live.title: Live or blind
info.steps.live.text: Ticked, the rig shows the step as you program it, programmer included. Untick it to work blind without changing the lights.
info.steps.pixels.title: Pixels
info.steps.pixels.text: Each segment of a pixel bar can be picked on its own: click, shift-drag for a range, double-click for the whole bar. Pixels are colour only: MASTER still owns each segment's dimmer (0.05 band).
info.shows.shows.title: Shows
info.shows.shows.text: A show is made of sets, and a set of steps: each step plays a scene for a number of times through, seconds, beats or bars, fading in from the one before. An auto set makes a fresh scene every step from a style.
info.shows.setlists.title: Setlists
info.shows.setlists.text: The songs for a gig in order. Each song plays a show and set, a scene or an autopilot preset. Run it from the Live page.
info.review.review.title: Review
info.review.review.text: Go through the looks this rig can do. Rate them, or ban the ones you never want: the autopilot and the generator follow.
info.review.rating.title: Like, dislike, ban
info.review.rating.text: Like makes a look come up more, dislike less; ban means the autopilot and generator never use it. Clear removes the rating. Auto moves on by itself every few seconds.
info.review.generator.title: Generator
info.review.generator.text: Makes normal scenes and shows from the FX banks for this rig: edit them in the scene builder afterwards. The same seed makes the same files.
info.palettes.palettes.title: Palettes
info.palettes.palettes.text: Palettes are sets of colours with tags (warm, cool, low, mid, high); the Autopilot page and auto show pick them by tag. Named colours are used by scenes by name.
info.palettes.named.title: Named colours
info.palettes.named.text: Change a named colour and every scene using it changes. A colour still in use can't be deleted.
info.layout.universes.title: Universes
info.layout.universes.text: One tab per DMX universe in the rig, with whether its interface is sending. A light's universe and address are set in the fixture list.
info.layout.arrange.title: Arrange
info.layout.arrange.text: Line up the picked lights: align, spread evenly, make a row, ring or grid, rotate or flip them. Pixel bars can be reversed to match how they're mounted. Ctrl+Z undoes.
info.layout.addresses.title: Addresses
info.layout.addresses.text: Each light's channels, and the value going out on every channel now (0-255). Pick which interface's frame to show.
info.layout.fixtures.title: Fixture list
info.layout.fixtures.text: Each light's type, channels, universe, address, groups and output. Edit in the table; clashing addresses show in red. Save patch writes it to the rig file.
info.layout.routing.title: Outputs
info.layout.routing.text: Which interface sends which universe, and how it's going: frames a second, frames, errors and the last frame. Changes apply between frames, no restart.
info.layout.groups.title: Groups
info.layout.groups.text: Pick lights, then make a group: scenes and MIDI flashes can use it by name. Renaming updates every scene, rig and MIDI map that uses the group.
info.fixtures.patch.title: Patch
info.fixtures.patch.text: Each light: its type, DMX universe and start address, groups, and the sub-master it follows. Overlapping addresses are marked red.
info.fixtures.rig.title: Rig settings
info.fixtures.rig.text: Changes apply straight away; DMX outputs, MIDI inputs and OSC apply after a restart.
info.heads.points.title: Head points
info.heads.points.text: Named places on stage (drum riser, singer) that heads aim at; scenes and the autopilot use them by name. The re-focus walk goes through every point, head by head, to correct them at the venue.
info.heads.store.title: Store a point
info.heads.store.text: Drag on a pad to hold that head at a spot (head limits still apply), then store it to a named point. Release hands it back to the show.
info.midi.inputs.title: Named inputs
info.midi.inputs.text: Name each pad, pedal or key once; mappings, step scenes and the auto show use the name. Change a note here and everything follows.
info.midi.monitor.title: MIDI monitor
info.midi.monitor.text: Every MIDI event as it arrives and what it matched. For filters, the pad heat map and MIDI out, use the Monitor page.
info.midi.learn.title: Learn
info.midi.learn.text: Press Learn, then hit the pad or pedal: the app catches it and fills in the mapping.
info.midi.mapping.title: MIDI map
info.midi.mapping.text: What each named input does: MASTER, flashes, scenes, Override buttons, autopilot controls or faders. One line per input and action.
info.monitor.dmx.title: DMX out
info.monitor.dmx.text: The frame an interface really sent, after the grand master, sub-masters, MASTER and head limits. Red when no frames go out, every channel is 0 or frames stopped. Nothing here changes the lights.
info.monitor.midi_in.title: MIDI in
info.monitor.midi_in.text: Every event with its port, note, velocity, the named input it matched and what it did, or unmapped. Learn on an event makes a named input from it.
info.monitor.midi_out.title: MIDI out
info.monitor.midi_out.text: Everything the app sends, per port. Test send sends a note, CC or program change (not under gig lock). Turn a port on in Setup > Plugged in.
info.setup.find.title: Find a light
info.setup.find.text: Tap a light to pick it out on the rig; tap it again to stop.
info.setup.tester.title: Channel tester
info.setup.tester.text: Set one DMX channel by hand to check a light. The haze channel is refused (rule 5): use the haze controls. Release and Clear tests hand the channels back to the show.
info.setup.found.title: Plugged in
info.setup.found.text: Each device by the name it reports. Give it a name and say what it's for; it's kept by its serial number, so a new COM port doesn't matter. Under gig lock, Use this instead still swaps a failed interface for a spare.
info.setup.nodes.title: Nodes
info.setup.nodes.text: The wireless receivers: signal, loss, and when each last got data. Resend setup sends a node its settings again; move the radio channel if the Wi-Fi is busy.
info.setup.access.title: Phones and the PIN
info.setup.access.text: Lets phones on the same Wi-Fi use the app, signed in with a PIN. Access settings can only be changed on the laptop.
info.setup.claude.title: Connect to Claude
info.setup.claude.text: Optional: connect Claude Desktop so it can read the show and help build scenes. Gig lock stops Claude changing anything during a show.
info.setup.appearance.title: Appearance
info.setup.appearance.text: Theme and button size. Compact fits more on a laptop screen; Comfortable gives bigger buttons for a touch screen.
info.files.project.title: Show file
info.files.project.text: Everything for a show (lights, scenes, shows, MIDI map) in one .dms file. Open, Save as or New here, or download and upload it to move it between computers.
info.files.history.title: History
info.files.history.text: Every change since the app started, newest first (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y). Older changes: the backups below.
info.files.backups.title: Backups
info.files.backups.text: Every change from here or from Claude keeps the previous file. Restore puts one file back.
layout.unsaved_leave: Layout not saved: Live and Autopilot show the saved one. Save layout to use it.
autopilot.exclude_tip: Leave types out of the autopilot: they turn red and it never picks them (you can still play them)
autopilot.exclude_help: Tap a type to leave it out of the autopilot (red), or to put it back. Tap Done when finished. Holding a type down does the same at any time.
test.title: Test patterns
test.note: Straight to the interface: scenes, autopilot, Override, grand master and MASTER are bypassed. Head limits still apply, haze stays off, strobe stays off in All full. Leaving this page stops the test.
info.test.title: Test patterns
info.test.text: Does DMX reach the lights at all? All full: everything on. Fixture chase: one light at a time, name shown large. Find fixture: one light flashes (heads nod). Channel ramp: one channel 0-255-0, or held. Keep-alive: a fixed frame, to see if lights stay in DMX mode. Stops on Stop, on leaving this page or at the timeout. Gig lock: Keep-alive only.
cycle.tip: USB DMX (Open): try each break method for 5 s with All full; tap Lights responded when the lights come on
cycle.no_response: No step confirmed: the output is back as it was ({method}, {us} µs)
cycle.stopped: Cycle test stopped: the output is back as it was
timing.line: {driver} · {method} · break {brk} µs (target {tbrk}) · MAB {mab} µs (target {tmab}) · {fps} fps (target {tfps}) · write {write} ms · jitter {jit} ms
checks.latency_confirm: Set the FTDI latency timer on this interface to 1 ms now (through D2XX)? The setting stays on the interface.

darkness.title: Darkness
info.darkness.title: Darkness
info.darkness.text: Puts black into the Autopilot's effects: narrower bands, black slots in palettes, gaps between colours. Not a dimmer: MASTER, dimmers and haze are untouched, the kick light keeps its look, hand-made scenes play as made. Store for set: LOW / MID / HIGH load their own value.
steps.lit_tip: How much of the colour is lit; the rest is black (colour off, never the dimmer): 50 = every other light / pixel

info.tempo2.title: Tempo
info.tempo2.text: Drums: the tempo from all the drums, seeded by a tap or a count-in. Lanes: each hit by drum, with the beat grid (bar lines thicker). Graph: raw tempo (thin) and what the lights follow (thick). Under the confidence threshold it freewheels at the last tempo.
tempo.drums: drums (seeded by a tap or count-in)
kit.title: Drum Kit
kit.derived: From the drum inputs: the first change saves it as a kit (the MIDI map is backed up).
kit.unmapped: Notes heard that aren't in the kit: {notes}
info.kit.title: Drum Kit
info.kit.text: The drummer's kit, defined once: tempo, drum flash and trigger pads all read it. Learn a zone and hit its pad. Notes heard that aren't in the kit show below in amber. Flash targets live here, not in the MIDI map. Export / Import moves a kit to another laptop.
